trigger_or_context: Something bothers you in a family relationship, and speaking up could cause tension.
short_term_function: Keeping the peace helps you avoid conflict and tension in the moment.
developmental_cost: Your own feelings and needs stay hidden, so others never learn what really bothers you.
adaptive_alternative_1: When something bothers you, say one true thing about how you feel. You do not have to fix it or fight. Just let your view be known.
what_new_response_supports: People get to know what you really think. You find out if the calm was real or just quiet.
expected_discomfort_or_cost: Things may feel tense for a bit. Someone may not like hearing it.
context_conditions: Keeping the peace is fine at times. This is about when you always do it and hide how you feel. If a home is not safe, staying quiet can be a way to stay safe.
review_reason: Cross-Phase source gap: no competency cleanly maps and there is no single developmental task. This is a family context (Adult Children & Parents), so a safety condition is named.
